items.html: Our paper Language Generation with Replay: A Learning-Theoretic View of Model Collapse was accepted at ICML 2026.

Three papers were accepted at TPDP 2026: Less Noise, Same Certificate: Retain Sensitivity for Unlearning, Adaptive Sampling for Private Worst-Case Group Optimization, and LoRA and Privacy: When Random Projections Help (and When They Don't).
Our paper “Learning in an Echo Chamber: Online Learning with Replay Adversary” was accepted at SODA 2026 and selected for FORC highlights.
Our paper “Delta-Influence: Identifying Poisons via Influence Functions” was accepted at TMLR.
Our paper titled An Iterative Algorithm for Differentially Private k-PCA with Adaptive Noise is accepted to NeurIPS 2025. See you in San Diego and Copenhagen!
I will be co-hosting two events at EurIPS 2025: the Learning Theory Alliance affinity event and the EurIPS Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning Workshop.

I received the Villum Young Investigator Grant and will be working on topics related to privacy, unlearning, and online learning. I will be hiring motivated PhD students and Postdocs. Email me if you think you would be a good match.
Three papers on differentially private alignment of LLMs, machine unlearning, and training data attribution were accepted at ICLR 2025 and one paper on OOD robustness and label noise at AISTATS 2025.
